title: Italian Spicy Energy Balls
description: These bite-sized energy balls are perfect for a quick Italian-inspired snack. With a kick of heat from the spicy peppers, they're a great way to refuel on-the-go.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chopped spicy peppers, eggs, almond flour, honey, vanilla extract, and salt.
Mix well until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Roll each ball in coconut flakes to coat.
Place the energy balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
